agent.harness: OpenCode 2.4.1 (opencode run, non-interactive, permissions approved automatically)
agent.session: a new session in an empty folder outside the recipe author's workspace, given only the prompt

prompt: Build an application from the OurPoker recipe: https://clodhub.com/recipes/ourpoker-recipe.txt
conditions: The session started in an empty temporary folder and read nothing from the workspace. It ran non-interactively, so its one round of questions was cancelled and it took the recipe's defaults, choosing own-hardware for the server question, which has no default. clod verify --trusted --allow-network, after the agent installed Kotlin 2.2.21 itself: 86 required-local passed; 43 platform passed; 5 platform and 1 deployed blocked (context missing); 1 platform blocked (kotlin-policy, tool version mismatch). Without Kotlin 2.2, 20 Android checks were blocked as tool unavailable.

measured.method: OpenCode's JSON event stream, from the prompt to the agent's final report; nothing waited for a person

results.ran: on Node on this Mac; health check answers

results.tested: browser check: page loads, a player sits, a hand is dealt, the table fits 1280x800 and 390x844, no script error
results.ran: vite preview against the local server

results.tested: built for the iOS simulator, unsigned
built for the Apple TV simulator, unsigned
unsigned installer built on the Mac; desktop tests 2 of 2

update: none: no deploy, so no two-step update
problems: clod doctor reported every tool ok, but 20 Android platform checks need kotlinc 2.2, which doctor does not check; the agent downloaded Kotlin 2.2.21 from GitHub to run them.
The display-mode kotlin-policy check stays blocked with a tool version mismatch even with Kotlin 2.2.21; nothing says which version it needs.
The Cloudflare path was not exercised: with no person to answer, the agent chose own-hardware.
The agent left the server and the web preview running, so the non-interactive session did not exit after its final report.
The Vite chunk-size warning (over 500 kB) appears again in the web and desktop builds.
The agent once wrote results for background builds before they finished, then retracted them itself; the final report matches the logs.

rating.mostHelpful: clod doctor should check for every tool the package checks need, including the exact Kotlin compiler versions, so clod verify does not stop on a missing or mismatched kotlinc that the doctor reported as fine.
